commonPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one original PNG sprite sheet for a cozy Chinese countryside garden mobile game. Requested size exactly 1536 x 1536 px, invisible 3 x 3 grid, equal 512 x 512 cells. Exactly one isolated asset per occupied cell in reading order. Each item stays inside its own cell with generous empty margins: minimum 60px on all four sides, no overlap, no clipping. Keep all asset silhouettes within the middle 70% of the cell; small animals, flowers, vegetables 40-50% cell height; trees/buildings maximum 75% to preserve margins. Align base toward bottom center consistently. No visible grid, labels, text, watermark, ground plane, landscape tile, cast shadows or connected scenery. Intrinsic pots, pond rim or building floor are allowed.
UNIFIED STYLE: Cute 3D isometric mobile-game asset, soft rounded chunky shapes, matte clay-like material with subtle texture, warm cheerful pastel colors, soft global illumination from the upper left, gentle ambient occlusion, no hard cast shadows, simple readable silhouette, cozy Chinese countryside garden theme (NOT Japanese: no torii, no kadomatsu), consistent isometric camera (about 30 degree elevation, object turned 45 degrees), each object stands alone with its base at the bottom center of its cell, no ground plane under it, no text, no labels, no borders. True transparent PNG background, no checkerboard painted into image. If transparency is impossible, perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF and no magenta in the assets. Make the entire set charming, rounded and cohesive, clear at 256px.
